description: This file implements the interface for message bus communication in the WAN Manager component, including initialization, finalization, resource management, and bus checking functions, as well as setting up callbacks and event registration.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Connects to the message bus, sets up callback functions, and registers an event signal.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface, currently a placeholder returning success.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the message bus interface, calls ssp_cancel() to clean up.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the bus status, currently always returns 0.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources based on priority; high priority triggers ssp_cancel().
